name: Python 3.11 + uv (on mcr image)
onCreateCommand: bash -lc 'set -eux; curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh; export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH; if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then uv venv && uv sync --dev; elif [ -f requirements.txt ]; then uv venv && uv pip install -r requirements.txt; fi'
